limitations: This recommendation covers the selected review sample and historical experiences. Current relevance requires validation. Reviews are self-selected and reflect an unknown mix of user histories; issue labels and severity judgments may be uncertain. The aggregates do not establish prevalence among all users, causation, or actual churn. Any cancellation mentioned in reviews is expressed intent only.
rationale: Prioritize usability for investigation because its aggregate priority score leads the alternatives, supported by reports of accidental loss of favorited songs and difficulty controlling a feature. Playback is a strong alternative: it has higher mean severity and reports describe historical playback disruption and device instability. The cited crash report was later updated to say the problem was fixed, so it supports historical experience rather than an unresolved defect. Billing merits attention for reports of unexpected charges and ads despite a paid subscription; access is another serious concern where users describe losing account access and saved content. These are prioritization signals from complaints, not verified product-wide rates or proof that any issue caused account loss or cancellation.
